mp_her_text: A fingertip presses firmly into her left thumb and holds there.
An ice cube touches her left thumb, cold and wet, then slides away.
A soft paintbrush is drawn along her left thumb, bristles cool and dry.
A drop of warm water lands on her left thumb and slowly runs off.
